finding.expected: Make the bounded P7.3 value/projection boundary deterministically guarantee that forbidden sensitive or raw payload classes required by TASK-215 cannot appear in public projections, without creating evidence, persistence, identity, or model authority. Add focused offline tests proving the forbidden projection classes fail closed while preserving the existing caller-order, immutability, opaque-reference, and pure-construction semantics.
finding.issue: The public DecisionContext.to_dict and OpportunityHypothesis.to_dict projections return caller-supplied strings verbatim after only type, blank, length, ordering, and duplicate validation. The TASK-215 hard contract requires those public projections to contain no secret, raw HTML, cookie/session data, model prompt, hidden execution metadata, object repr, or memory address. A caller can currently place such content in context text, subject or evidence references, assumptions, constraints, unknowns, conditions, or expected outcomes and the projection emits it unchanged. The focused tests do not exercise this required fail-closed projection boundary, so the Runtime PASS does not establish that hard semantic constraint.
